subject: agent://curia.example/tuesdaycrowd/scriptor
note: A genuine statement whose authorization header is the text of a header that lists kid twice (a stranger's, then O's), signed validly by O over that text, then a genuine attestation at 4: the ADMIT profile refuses a repeated member, so the header is no object the procedure reads (a reader that takes the last kid honours the row, one that takes the first skips it as act-key-unpublished). Statements are the exact output of CanonicalizeWithNfc, each signature is detached under curia-operator-act+jws with the key's thumbprint as the header kid; the keys the case publishes are its own log.operator-key, log.key and log.declaration-key entries. expected.json is written from this construction and never by running a verifier. A proposal: it may be regenerated until the owner's lift record pins its digests.
